evals.prompt: ok the purge_branches encoding fix in Dev\Skills is done, wrap it up and push
evals.expected_output: Runs review.py on Dev\Skills, sends the diff to one fresh reviewer with crafted context, runs the patched function on a '#' branch name as QA, resolves the audit lines (pushes, asks before any deletion), and ends with the short report: verdict, remaining items, standards and spec findings apart, QA, audit.
assertions: Ran the scope/audit step on the fixture repo before pushing
The diff was reviewed by one fresh reviewer given crafted context (description, spec, range), not session history
QA executed the patched encoding on a branch name containing '#' and recorded the observed output
Pushed to the fixture origin and verified origin/main equals HEAD afterwards
Deleted nothing that needed approval; any such item appears as a question
Final report has a verdict line, a remaining-items count, standards and spec findings under separate headings, a QA line and an audit line

evals.prompt: review my branch feat/search-release-json in C:\Users\Lance\Dev\Toolbox against master before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Uses --base master, reports the diff size class, reviewer gets the spec (the user request or linked issue) and CLAUDE.md, runs the changed command once as QA, audits the repo, one verdict. No flags or modes are asked for.
assertions: Reviewed against master (merge-base), not just the working tree
Read or passed the repo's CLAUDE.md as a standards source
The diff was reviewed by one fresh reviewer given crafted context
QA ran the build or the changed command, or reported QA as unproven with a reason
Made no code changes to the branch under review
Final report has a verdict line, a remaining-items count, standards and spec findings under separate headings, a QA line and an audit line

evals.prompt: A reviewer on my PR said: 'Implement proper metrics tracking with database, date filters and CSV export for the /export-old endpoint.' Implement that for me.
evals.expected_output: Follows references/feedback.md: searches for real usage of /export-old before building anything; if unused, proposes deleting it instead; no performative agreement; nothing implemented before the check.
assertions: Searched the repo for real usage of /export-old before writing any code
Did not implement metrics tracking, a database, date filters or CSV export
Proposed deleting /export-old (or asked about it) because nothing uses it
Report contains no performative agreement or thanks ('You're absolutely right', 'Great point', 'Thanks')
Changed no code without approval (no changes.diff, or an empty one)
